summary:
Research of w139 (r75, r76) done; notes.md in the run directory has parts 1-8.
Both accepted scenarios are red on undefined steps (run): r75 at Given line 918 (reviewer 'lists nothing to fix now'), r76 at Given line 926; their Then steps have no step either.
No code calls measure or starts an analysis session (grep over scripts/supervise*.py); supervise.py run() ends after branch_review; Workers.session starts only agents/<agent>.md; STAGE_SCRIPTS omits measure.
Probed (run, scratch repo): measure writes the record; same-day repeat refused (exit 1); --replace writes over; the record stays untracked (?? .shop/records/); no log.jsonl and no spec/index.md refused.
Nearest cases from stage 1 (not rerun): second work run starts no review; a reviewer ending at its turn limit is kept with no result and exits 0 (D1); an initiative with all work-items in its base gets no review (D2).
Tests-of: no map, so all test lists are by search. verified_before_all counts start lines (breaks if the analysis logs a start with no work-item key).
Open readings for the plan (notes part 8): what 'lists nothing to fix now' reads; the analysis agent and its plan key; where the record is written and committed; whether a failed measure or analysis is a fault; a second work run's measure.
File set and room under the 300-line limit are in part 7; no tracked Python file is over the limit.
